tagline: The Runaway Bride · 故事导读
intro: Jiang Mingyue wakes up inside a novel—right in the middle of a terrible act. She tries to save the bride from a marriage she never wanted, only to discover that Wen Li has a plan of her own.
intro_zh: 姜明月醒来时，发现自己成了小说中的恶毒女配，正准备给新娘温梨下药。为了改变自己的结局，她选择帮温梨逃婚，但事情远不止婚礼这么简单。
learning_goals: Read a complete English story while following its characters and clues.
Recognize natural spoken expressions, narrative pacing, and character intentions.
Retell major events in your own English.
study_tips: Start with English. Use Chinese only when needed.
Listen to dialogue and repeat expressions you want to remember.
Use the chapter review to summarize the plot before moving on.
